name: RowVista Slider
author: Faisal Liaqat

sections.description:
RowVista Slider is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that allows you to create a beautiful two-row responsive slider using any custom post type. It uses the popular Slick Carousel for smooth animations and full responsiveness.

Key Features:
– Select any custom post type (posts, products, etc.)
– Choose number of posts, rows, and slides to show
– Enable/disable autoplay
– Choose post order (ASC/DESC)
– Add Font Awesome or custom image arrows
– Embed the slider anywhere using the [rowvista-slider] shortcode

Great For:
– Showcasing recent blog posts
– Displaying WooCommerce products
– Featuring portfolio items

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to RowVista Slider → Settings to configure the slider options.
  4. Add the [rowvista-slider] shortcode to any page, post, or widget where you’d like the slider to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I insert the slider into a page or post?

Use the shortcode [rowvista-slider] anywhere inside content blocks or templates.

Can I use a custom post type like “product”?

Yes! Just choose the post type from the dropdown in plugin settings.

Can I change the slider arrow icons?

Yes, you can select between Font Awesome icons or upload custom images for arrows.
